title: Chapter 575
text:
/>

Underworld Feather's seat was beside the pilot. She glanced at the pilot and spoke softly.

"Are you afraid?"

The pilot swallowed his saliva and said, "No, no."

"Don't be nervous. Eat something." Underworld Feather took out a red jerky that looked suspicious and stuffed it in front of the pilot's mouth. She gave him a smile that looked friendly but was actually filled with evil intentions.

The pilot bit the bullet and ate it. It actually tasted pretty good. He smacked his lips and asked curiously, "What kind of meat is this?"

Just as Underworld Feather was about to speak, Han Xiao helplessly opened his eyes and interrupted, "If you don't want to vomit, don't ask."

He had already figured out Underworld Feather's methods. She pretended to share food enthusiastically but purposely fed other people weird things to satisfy her own bad taste. This little girl was quite good at acting innocent.

"Tsk." Underworld Feather turned her face away.

…

Han Xiao and the rest arrived at the venue in an aircraft and sat down in their respective seats. The galactic reporters immediately started snapping away.

"Those people seem to be the leaders of large mercenary groups."

"That's right. They are all famous mercenaries. They should have participated in the war."

Below the stage, countless reporters whispered to each other.

After waiting for a short while, aircraft after aircraft flew over from the direction of the political core building. The leaders of Godora had finally arrived, and they entered and took their seats one after another. The atmosphere was extremely ceremonial, and Han Xiao felt as though he was walking down a red carpet.

Serbia the Fifth was the last to appear. The moment he appeared, the entire venue cheered. The crowd also cheered excitedly. Their voices shook the clouds, and they won the hearts of the people.

Han Xiao casually glanced at the guest seats below the stage. Other than the reporters, the people seated were all elites of Godora. Basically, they were all pure-blooded Godora people. Even if there were a few mixed-bloods, they did not look too abnormal.

Serbia the Fifth gestured with his hands and waited for the entire venue to quiet down. Then, he slowly started his speech. His voice was amplified by magic.

Only then did the celebration officially begin. It was broadcasted on various galactic channels.

At the beginning, it was naturally a full set of official statements, thanking the people from all walks of life for their efforts, emphasizing the achievements of the government, continuing to implement the various policies of the government, reminiscing about the past, and so on.

After a long speech, Godora sat upright and still with a serious face. Han Xiao did not have Godora's patriotic sentiments and almost fell asleep listening to the speech. At this moment, Serbia the Fifth finally changed the topic and entered the main topic.

"I have an important announcement to make … Dark-star is a terrorist organization that uses racial discrimination as an excuse to wantonly slaughter people. All along, Dark-star has not given up on destroying Godora and has dealt a heavy blow to our society. They have committed countless tragedies, and their hands are stained with blood! We have never been afraid of any form of provocation and have always tried our best to stop Dark-star's activities. Just 13 days ago, we finally made a breakthrough — we eliminated the Dark-star! "

Boom!

Godora's people were excited and cheered loudly. Even though the officials had already briefed them beforehand, this news came from Serbia the Fifth's mouth.

The sound waves were too powerful, deafening even the apathetic, making people involuntarily want to sway.

At this moment, in the VIP area, Underworld Feather quietly poked Han Xiao's waist and whispered, "Can you hear me?"

Han Xiao turned around and asked curiously, "Yes, why?"

"I'm just checking if you're deaf." Underworld Feather was expressionless.

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. Underworld Feather did not care about the countless gazes and cameras around her. She took out a bag of snacks and started munching on them. She even spat out the shells on his back like a machine gun, trying her best to make her presence known. Han Xiao's mouth twitched even more.

Dark Elves are really vengeful …

The Godorans cheered for a while before they gradually stopped. The reporters realized that it was time to announce the details of the process, so they focused all their attention on Serbia the Fifth. The pens in their hands were steady, and they were ready to write a press release at any moment.

"This time, we received the help of a key person and locked onto the coordinates of Dark-star. In the end, we wiped out the entire Dark-star fleet …"

Serbia the Fifth spoke slowly, and the content was similar to what the various mercenary groups had guessed. He briefly described the battle process and emphasized the results.

The Godorans listened with bated breaths, and the galactic reporters hurriedly took out their notebooks to record it down. These words were broadcasted to the Shattered Star Ring, and countless galactic residents became very interested in the 'key person' that Serbia the Fifth had mentioned.

This' key person 'should be the source of the intelligence!

After Serbia the Fifth finished speaking, he signaled for the reporters to ask questions. All the interstellar reporters raised their hands in unison.

He randomly picked a reporter, and the reporter stood up.

"Your Majesty Serbia the Fifth, I would like to ask if it is convenient for you to reveal the identity of this key person."

Hearing this, the audience from the various Star Systems could not help but pout. Although they also wanted to know the source of the intelligence, this was clearly confidential, and Godora would definitely not reveal it.

This time, Serbia the Fifth smiled and suddenly changed the topic. "In fact, there is another important event in this celebration. I will be holding an award ceremony for someone and awarding him the Golden Gal Statue Medal."

Golden Gal Statue Medal?

The Godorans who were watching the broadcast, as well as the reporters, felt their brains explode. Their minds went blank from the shock of this piece of news.

Compared to the audience from the other Star Systems who were confused, they understood the importance of this medal more.

In the history of Godora, the Golden Gal Statue Medal was the highest honor, and it had only been given out thirty-two times. That was thousands of years of history. This medal could be said to be extremely rare!

Every time, it was awarded to great people who had made groundbreaking contributions, such as the Chief Scientist, the War Marshal, the wise leader, and so on. They were all heroic figures.

At least half of them received the honor of the Golden Gal Statue Medal many years after they had passed away.

Who knew how many years had passed since the last time this medal was given out? Who would have thought that someone would finally receive this highest honor?

This was unexpected and sensational news!

The reporters came back to their senses, and their faces were red with excitement.

Serbia the Fifth turned to look at the VIP area, and countless eyes and cameras followed his line of sight.

Han Xiao grinned, stood up, and met Serbia the Fifth's kind gaze. He braced himself and walked over.

It was not because he was nervous.

It was because he still had a lot of melon seed shells on his back …

"Let me introduce to everyone, the winner of the Golden Gal Statue Medal, Black Star!"

At this moment, it was as if a vacuum blower had sucked all the air in the venue dry.

Countless people subconsciously took a deep breath, and their faces were filled with confusion.

Suddenly, the entire venue was in an uproar!

The various Army Commanders were stunned, and Underworld Feather swallowed the melon seed shell in her mouth. She was so shocked that she could not close her legs.

The hundreds of thousands of army players who were watching the broadcast had their eyes wide open.

The army officers who were playing cards while watching the television all had their mouths wide open, and the cards in their hands fell to the ground.

Even many Godora officials who did not know what was going on had a look of disbelief.
